standard: IEEE 1800-2023 7.12.1: find_index returns the indices of the elements, and the first element is the one closest to the leftmost indexed element; 7.12.4: item.index returns the index value; 6.11: byte is a signed integer type, so min of {1, -2, 3, -4} is -4.
